description: Identity corpus inventory for observed harness/model identity capture and verification. Exercises the full identity receipt lifecycle through the deterministic fixture omnigent with real compatible Omnigent.

test_cases.name: selection-changes-actual-invocation
test_cases.description: A selection differing from bundle defaults changes the actual Omnigent --harness/--model invocation rather than only ledger metadata

test_cases.name: requested-invoked-observed-receipts-independent
test_cases.description: Requested, invoked, and observed receipts independently record canonical harness/provider/model, bundle/config digest, role, session/conversation ID, provenance, and context digest

test_cases.name: missing-observed-receipt-fails-closed
test_cases.description: Missing observed identity receipt (no root conversation created) fails closed

test_cases.name: harness-mismatch-fails-closed
test_cases.description: Harness mismatch between requested and observed fails closed

test_cases.name: model-mismatch-fails-closed
test_cases.description: Model mismatch between requested and observed fails closed

test_cases.name: spoofed-transcript-is-not-observation
test_cases.description: Spoofed transcript text in stdout is not treated as identity observation

test_cases.name: stale-session-fails-closed
test_cases.description: A pre-existing (stale) conversation is not treated as the observed identity for this dispatch

test_cases.name: bundle-default-fallback-blocks
test_cases.description: Absence of --harness/--model in the invoked argv (bundle-default fallback) blocks identity verification

test_cases.name: unsupported-alias-fails-closed
test_cases.description: An unsupported alias that does not canonicalize to the same value as requested fails closed

test_cases.name: identity-receipt-set-digest-stable
test_cases.description: The identity receipt set digest is stable across replays of the same inputs
